rows.grounds: altar/ground to be prepared; accusative object of kārayet
sandhi fusion of kārayet and vidvān; optative 'should make/cause' with learned one as subject
eight droṇa measures; instrumental quantity; ca adds 'and'

items.question: What material and measure should the learned one use to make the ritual altar?
premises: eight droṇas of rice are used
items.inference: altar construction requires eight droṇas of rice
items.plain_english: The learned one should make the altar with eight droṇas of rice.
